overview: Fieldspend is a mobile-first PWA expense tracker for field sales professionals in India. It features automatic receipt scanning with OCR, PDF report generation, multi-language support (EN/HI/MR), and Razorpay in-app payments for premium subscriptions.
features: Receipt photo capture with auto-crop and OCR
PDF report generation with all receipts
Razorpay in-app premium subscription (₹99/month or ₹49/month annual)
Rewarded ad gates for free tier (upload and report triggers)
Auto-switch to paywall after July 31 2026 beta period
Dark mode and offline PWA support
